profile: PROCEPT BioRobotics develops, manufactures, and sells robotic systems for minimally invasive urologic surgery, initially focused on benign prostatic hyperplasia. Its AquaBeam and HYDROS systems use image-guided robotic technology and disposable handpieces to deliver Aquablation therapy, combining imaging, treatment planning, and heat-free waterjet ablation to remove prostate tissue. The company’s products are used by physicians treating men with urinary symptoms associated with BPH.
